inventory.name: [Nopalcyber]PowerShell Execution from Browser with Suspicious Arguments

native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [Nopalcyber]PowerShell Execution from Browser with Suspicious Arguments
native_rule.s1ql: src.process.name in:anycase ('powershell.exe', 'pwsh.exe') and  (src.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'FromBase64String' or   src.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'iex' or   src.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Invoke-Expression' or   src.process.cmdline contains:anycase '-enc' or   src.process.cmdline contains:anycase '-encoded') and src.process.parent.name in:anycase ('chrome.exe', 'firefox.exe', 'msedge.exe', 'iexplore.exe', 'opera.exe')
